🔥 NEW LISTING // HARKER HEIGHTS, TX 🔥
Looking for your dream home? This hidden gem in Harker Heights, TX is officially on the market and ready for YOU! 🏡✨

This stunning 4-sided brick beauty features 2,137 sqft of pure comfort:
🛌 4 BEDROOMS
🛁 2 BATHROOMS
🍽️ FORMAL DINING ROOM

✨ WHAT’S NEW & UPDATED:
🆕 ALL NEW KITCHEN APPLIANCES (Installed 2024 - they all convey!)
🧺 WASHER & DRYER INCLUDED (Washer is brand new 2025!)
☁️ BRAND NEW CARPET installed JUST NOW (June 2026! 🆕)
🔥 Cozy GAS (PROPANE) FIREPLACE for chilly nights
💧 Water heater updated in 2022!

🧱 Solid 4-SIDED BRICK construction with massive COVERED FRONT & BACK PORCHES — perfect for your morning coffee or weekend BBQs! ☕️🥩

📲 WANT MORE INFO?
DM me right now for the exact address, price, and a private tour, or drop a comment below! 🔑👇

Listing Courtesy of Aleida C. Flores, All City Real Estate
